{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter completed orders only
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Parse revenue as float
completed_data['revenue_numeric'] = completed_data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute average revenue within each customer segment for both channels
revenue_by_group = completed_data.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['revenue_numeric'].mean().reset_index()

# Extract the key comparisons: email vs paid_search within each segment
# For loyal customers
email_loyal = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'email') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'revenue_numeric'].iloc[0]
paid_search_loyal = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'), 'revenue_numeric'].iloc[0]
loyal_diff = email_loyal - paid_search_loyal

# For new customers
email_new = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'email') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'revenue_numeric'].iloc[0]
paid_search_new = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'new'), 'revenue_numeric'].iloc[0]
new_diff = email_new - paid_search_new

# For returning customers
email_returning = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'email') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'revenue_numeric'].iloc[0]
paid_search_returning = revenue_by_group.loc[(revenue_by_group['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (revenue_by_group['customer_segment'] == 'returning'), 'revenue_numeric'].iloc[0]
returning_diff = email_returning - paid_search_returning

# Print all differences
print(f"Loyal customers: email - paid_search = {loyal_diff:.2f} USD")
print(f"New customers: email - paid_search = {new_diff:.2f} USD")
print(f"Returning customers: email - paid_search = {returning_diff:.2f} USD")

# Summary of campaign impact per segment
print("\nCampaign impact (email - paid_search) by segment:")
impact_summary = pd.DataFrame({
    'Segment': ['Loyal', 'New', 'Returning'],
    'Email Avg': [email_loyal, email_new, email_returning],
    'Paid Search Avg': [paid_search_loyal, paid_search_new, paid_search_returning],
    'Difference (email - paid_search)': [loyal_diff, new_diff, returning_diff]
})
print(impact_summary)"}
